purpose: Teach: 多数決/同封/空席/値打ち/再選/内輪/詰め込み/関空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 重要案件、本気で、絶対、多数決、絶対、で、絶対、決めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: On this important case — decide by majority vote. I'm serious. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Lean forward slightly on the directive. Measured pace, no rush, but absolute finality in the tone. A boss who expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約書、本気で、絶対、同封、絶対、必要書類、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The contract and all required documents are prepared and ready. Thank you for entrusting this to me.
lines.style: Steady, professional delivery. Crisp emphasis on 「準備しております」 — showing capability without overstatement. Respectful but not servile. Even rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会、本気で、絶対、空席、絶対、補充、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Fill the vacant board seats. Move this forward. I need it done.
lines.style: Direct, minimal preamble. Sharp attack on the opening clause. Controlled urgency — not rushed, but expectant. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品の、本気で、絶対、値打ち、絶対、お客様、絶対、ご評価、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our products have been receiving strong evaluations from our customers. We're grateful for their confidence.
lines.style: Measured report delivered with quiet pride. Slight emphasis on 「ご評価いただいております」 — genuine satisfaction without boasting. Professional composure throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 代表取締役の、本気で、絶対、再選、絶対、株主、絶対、ご支持、絶対、いただけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The CEO reelection — I'm asking for the shareholders' continued support. It matters.
lines.style: Formal but weighted. Slight pause before the request itself, as if considering its gravity. Steady eye-level delivery. The tone of someone asking for something important but inevitable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議内容、本気で、絶対、内輪、絶対、で、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The meeting details are being kept in-house and organized properly. Thank you.
lines.style: Calm confirmation with underlying professionalism. Matter-of-fact about discretion — it's not in question, it's stated as fact. Even-paced, assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務の、本気で、絶対、詰め込み、絶対、過ぎ、絶対、ないよう、絶対、調整しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't let the workload become overwhelming. Adjust the load. That's an order.
lines.style: Shift to concern — quieter than the other directives but no less firm. Slight softening underneath the command, as if this one matters to him differently. Deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外出張、本気で、絶対、関空、絶対、発の便、絶対、手配しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged the overseas travel flights departing from Kansai Airport. Everything is set.
lines.style: Final confirmation delivered with settled efficiency. Slight emphasis on the logistical detail — 「手配しております」 shows thoroughness. Closing rhythm, slightly slower, as if wrapping up.
